Discover Premium Spray Dried Lemon Juice Powder

Tradenest Naturals is a trusted manufacturer and exporter of high-grade ingredients. We process fresh, juicy lemons into a fine, shelf-stable powder using advanced technology. Because we lock in authentic flavor, our product delivers the zesty punch of fresh citrus without the hassle of liquid storage. Food manufacturers and global buyers trust our spray dried lemon juice powder for consistent quality. As a leading dried lemon powder exporter, we ensure every batch meets strict international standards. Therefore, your formulations benefit from pure citrus notes and vibrant appearance every single time.

Advanced Manufacturing and Superior Quality

We source fresh lemons from trusted farms and extract their juice under hygienic conditions. Next, we use modern spray-drying chambers to dehydrate the liquid quickly. This method preserves natural vitamin C, volatile oils, and bright flavor profiles. Our facility follows strict food safety protocols to maintain batch traceability. In fact, every lot undergoes rigorous microbial testing before final packing. You receive a uniform, free-flowing powder that resists caking and dissolves easily in various formulations.

Key Applications in the Food and Beverage Industry

Our wholesale dried lemon powder serves a wide range of commercial applications. Beverage companies use it for instant drink premixes and iced tea blends. Meanwhile, snack manufacturers dust it over potato chips, popcorn, and extruded snacks for tangy flavor. Confectionery brands also add this versatile ingredient to fruit gummies, hard candies, and fillings. In addition, bakeries utilize it in lemon cakes, icings, and glaze mixtures. Because it is dry, it prevents unwanted moisture addition in dry mix recipes.

Why Partner with Tradenest Naturals?

Choosing the right spray dried lemon powder manufacturer impacts your product's market success. We offer competitive pricing, reliable supply chains, and customized packaging solutions. Moreover, our team provides complete export documentation for smooth customs clearance worldwide. We support growing brands through flexible minimum order quantities and private label options. Above all, we value long-term partnerships built on transparency and prompt communication. Connect with our sales team today to request a sample or quote for your business.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for spray dried lemon juice powder?

We offer flexible MOQ policies to support businesses of all sizes. Please contact our sales team with your exact volume requirements for a custom quote.

What certifications and quality standards apply?

Our products undergo strict quality checks, moisture control, and microbial testing to ensure compliance with global food safety regulations.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We pack our products in moisture-resistant export-grade bags and drums. When stored properly in a cool, dry place, the shelf life is up to 24 months.

What are the typical specifications?

Our powder features an 80-100 mesh size, low moisture content below 5%, and 100% purity without artificial additives or fillers.

How do I request a sample or quote?

Simply reach out via our website inquiry form or email us directly. Our export team responds promptly with pricing, lead times, and sample dispatch details.
